pricing_context_rules.base_rate_note: GPT-5.5 base API-equivalent uses input $5.00, cached input $0.50, output $30.00 per 1M tokens.
pricing_context_rules.long_context_surcharge_note: Official pricing applies 2x input and 1.5x output when prompts exceed 272K input tokens. Local Codex JSONL does not expose provider-side per-request context classification, so this report adds an upper-bound sensitivity instead of pretending exact surcharge billing.
pricing_context_rules.regional_uplift_note: Some regions can add about 10 percent. Local JSONL does not expose billing region, so this is a sensitivity row only.
pricing_context_rules.post_cutoff_long_context_event_rule: Lower-bound detector for post-cutoff positive delta events whose delta input_tokens exceeds 272000. Provider-side exact long-context classification remains unavailable in local JSONL; zero detected events is not proof of zero all-time surcharge.
